access_checklist.label: Official access procedure identified
access_checklist.evidence_needed: Confirm the Get Microdata route and responsible access authority.
access_checklist.next_action: Open the official Get Microdata workflow and document each required step; do not submit an application without owner approval.

access_checklist.label: Access request requirements documented
access_checklist.evidence_needed: Current registration, application, identity, purpose, and review requirements from the official access workflow.
access_checklist.next_action: Obtain the current process requirements from NISR/AFR and record the official instructions.

access_checklist.label: Exact release identifier confirmed for the local dataset
access_checklist.evidence_needed: Evidence that any acquired file is the catalogue release RWA-NISR-FINSCOPE-2024-v01.
access_checklist.next_action: Match release documentation and file provenance; no local file is currently present.

access_checklist.label: Permission or license obtained and reviewed
access_checklist.evidence_needed: Written project-specific data access authorization or license with reviewer and date.
access_checklist.next_action: Request permission through the official process and record its scope; do not infer it from public access.

access_checklist.label: Permitted-use restrictions recorded
access_checklist.evidence_needed: Terms for processing, storage, attribution, sharing, and publication.
access_checklist.next_action: Review the agreement or license and record restrictions separately from analytical approval.

access_checklist.label: Exact-release questionnaire obtained and reviewed
access_checklist.evidence_needed: Questionnaire tied to the exact release and review notes for the selected construct/universe.
access_checklist.next_action: Obtain and review the release-matched questionnaire through an approved channel.

access_checklist.label: Exact-release codebook or variable dictionary obtained and reviewed
access_checklist.evidence_needed: Release-matched codebook with variable labels, codes, universes, and nonresponse definitions.
access_checklist.next_action: Obtain and independently review the exact-release codebook; map semantics, not guessed names.

access_checklist.label: Methodology and sampling documentation obtained and reviewed
access_checklist.evidence_needed: Official design, weights, strata, clusters, variance and geographic coverage documentation.
access_checklist.next_action: Obtain technical/methodology documentation and document design-based estimation requirements.

access_checklist.label: Expected schema documented
access_checklist.evidence_needed: Expected variable schema extracted from reviewed exact-release documentation.
access_checklist.next_action: Record schema expectations and validate any authorized local file without exposing rows.

access_checklist.label: Data-quality requirements defined and reviewed
access_checklist.evidence_needed: Indicator-specific aggregate validation criteria and reviewer acceptance.
access_checklist.next_action: Define checks only after documentation and authorized intake; record acceptance without raw records.

access_checklist.label: Indicator definition and mappings independently verified
access_checklist.evidence_needed: Approved FI-ACCESS-001 definition and verified exact-release variable mapping records.
access_checklist.next_action: Resolve every definition-review field and mapping against the authorized documentation.

access_checklist.label: Analytical eligibility approved
access_checklist.evidence_needed: Separate reviewer decision after access, provenance, documentation, quality, mapping, and survey-design gates pass.
access_checklist.next_action: Record dataset-specific analytical approval only after all prerequisite evidence is verified.

access_checklist.label: Publication and disclosure requirements reviewed separately
access_checklist.evidence_needed: Output-specific license, disclosure, cell-size, attribution, and publication decision.
access_checklist.next_action: Complete a separate release review after analysis; analytical access does not imply publication permission.
